capabilities: Edit Markdown notes as XMind-style mind maps
Keep map and Markdown edits in sync
Import .xmind files and export maps as PNG, SVG, or PDF
Embed mind maps in notes and Canvas
Review maps with spaced repetition and FSRS
extras: Diagnostics are desktop-only; the plugin has no runtime dependencies and works on desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in mind map view for editing Markdown notes while keeping the Markdown file as the source of truth.

relations.evidence: Put an .xmind file in your vault and open it directly
copy a selection in PDF++ (the default format is fine), select a node in the map and press ⌘V
like in the gogoga Table plugin, without installing it
study recite-mode questions the Anki way

summary: XMind-style mind map editor that turns Markdown headings and list items into nodes and keeps map and note edits in sync.
